acceptance_criteria.notes: All 7 criteria in the sprint JSON verified by command: AC8 make ai-stub (both/gemini/none/textonly goldens, cache sums, VM == interpreter); AC8b cd ai && ailang test --package . 12/12 (route_test: text -> OpenRouter, else Gemini, else no_key; media never OpenRouter; text_only; 13 config refusals); AC6 part (27 text blobs vs shasum -a 256, incl. the non-ASCII line); AC7 part make strict-ai aiWireVm; deps-ai lock unchanged except generated_at; grep 'Amendment 2026-10-02: both providers' present at design doc :558; make test green.

code_quality.notes: Clean module split (key/route/wire pure; cache FS; service IO+FS), hand-written inverse codecs, routing refused at start with a named fault for each of 13 bad configs, defence in depth in pick() (serves checked again at resolve time). Sprint JSON milestone complete (passes, dates, actual_loc, notes); sprint plan status updated. No TODO/FIXME; largest file 161 lines; no long functions. -2: ai/service.ail:39 treats an empty line as end of input, so a blank line mid-stream ends the service silently (probe: request after the blank line never answered) — Godot's relay must never emit one. -1: the two cache invariants the design states (temp+rename, index appended before the result is printed; ai/cache.ail:36-38, ai/service.ail:45-46) have no test: my mutants removing the rename and swapping say/writeBlob survive both the package tests and make ai-stub. -1: wire.errorCodes 'text_only' (ai/wire.ail:43) is not covered by any decoder test (dropping it survives everything; wire_test outLines has no text_only result line).

documentation.notes: Design doc carries the dated amendment with the full before/now table (providers, routing, keys, text-only, wire, config, cost, build keys, allowlist) plus an 'AI.4 as built' paragraph; it cites the sprint plan's 'Plan change: both providers' section (exists, sprint :71). Module headers explain each deviation and cite ailang#1516/#1517 at the workaround sites (provider.ail:81, wire_test.ail:41-42). PR body accurate. -3: CHANGELOG untouched (landing step per CLAUDE.md; same small deduction as AI.1/AI.2). -1: design doc :3 Status still reads 'awaiting Mark's answers to the open questions' although D-20 resolved them on 2026-10-02.

design_fidelity.notes: Matches (a2) and (a4) and Mark's both-providers ruling: text -> OpenRouter then Gemini then no_key; portrait/avatar/voice -> Gemini only, and OpenRouter for a media kind is refused at start AND skipped at resolve time; text-only mode answers media text_only while text still routes; both keys optional; stub cannot spend (--caps IO,FS, verified at the runtime level). Cache layout blobs/ab/<sha>.<ext> + append-only index.ndjson with origin 'library', provider/route/model/input_sha256/seed and width/height for images, per (a4). Every deviation is documented in the amendment and judged acceptable below. -1: hello hardcodes provider 'stub' and live false (ai/service.ail:33) rather than deriving them from the Provider value — fine for AI.4 but AI.5 must change it; and a routed voice request is answered provider_error, which the sim will read as a real provider failure (placeholder until AI.5's stub voice).

automated_checks.make_ai_stub: exit 0: both 7 gemini/4 none/11 openrouter; gemini 18/4; none 22 none; textonly 11 none/11 openrouter; cache 34 == SHA256SUMS; 27 text blobs == shasum; silent until first input; provider gemini refused at start
automated_checks.make_ai_mutants: exit 0: 6/6 killed (route guard, key presence, text_only, entity-id length, spelled numbers, meta.route), each by its named test

evaluator_verifications.routing: Verified from goldens, route_test and an extra openrouter-only run: text -> openrouter (both keys), gemini (Gemini only), openrouter (OpenRouter only), no_key (none); portrait/avatar/voice -> gemini or no_key, never openrouter (openrouter-only set: req 9/11/12 all no_key, route none); text_only: media answer text_only, text still routes to openrouter. Bad configs each refused with exactly one fatal line and nothing else, even when two hellos are sent: unknown key, live provider, unreadable routing file, OpenRouter for portrait, a kind with no route (ai/route.ail parseRouting, ai/service.ail start).
evaluator_verifications.isolation: grep over ai/*.ail: imports are std/* and ./key|route|wire|provider|cache only; no stapledons/sim, no ../sim; no std/env, std/net, std/ai, getEnv, httpRequest anywhere in ai/.
evaluator_verifications.capabilities: Runtime-level check: a probe program calling std/env.getEnv under --caps IO,FS dies with "effect 'Env' requires capability, but none provided"; the same program with --caps IO,FS,Env prints the fake value. The service run with GOOGLE_API_KEY=AIzaFAKE… and OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-FAKE… in the environment and keys_present [] answers no_key for everything; with --caps IO,FS,Env,Net granted the output is byte-identical, and no FAKE text appears in any output: the service never consults the environment.
evaluator_verifications.key_hygiene: git ls-files | xargs grep -E 'AIza|sk-or-': only the grep rules themselves (mk/ai.mk:44-45, sprint JSON AI.7 text, sprint plan risk row); binary PNG fixtures also clean. The pattern 'sk-or-' in error output is impossible: keys are never read.
evaluator_verifications.cache: ai/cache.ail:36-38 writes <path>.tmp then renameFile; the index line is appended (ai/cache.ail:40) inside writeBlob, which service.ail:45 calls before say(h.out) at :46. No .tmp files left after a run. Every .txt blob's name equals shasum -a 256 of its bytes, including the non-ASCII line (8baeec50…, 'Élise, ça va? … 星 … —'). Index lines carry no clock and no request id; the same key set yields the same index sha in SHA256SUMS. Dedup: the same PNG for req 10 and 11 is written once with two index lines.
evaluator_verifications.d21: Only one ok text body in all four goldens contains a digit: the deliberate 'digits' negative fixture (req 4). Stub lines spell the request number ('one', 'two', 'three', 'two-zero'); the news/archive/probe phrases carry no digits. stubText uses digits only when the request says no_numerals false (ai/provider.ail:88); the sim always sends true (sim/ai.ail:139).
evaluator_verifications.silence: Valid config + empty stdin prints nothing (make ai-stub check and my probe). Exception noted below: a BAD config + empty stdin prints the fatal line after readLine returns '' (ai/service.ail:98-99).
evaluator_verifications.determinism: make ai-stub: every key set cmp-identical on VM and interpreter (stdout and cache dir via diff -r); goldens unchanged across my three re-runs; strict aiWireVm digest 3f37195d4bf2e5f6 identical on both runtimes.

adversarial_probes.blank_line_mid_stream: FOUND: hello, request 1, an empty line, request 3 -> the service answered hello and request 1 and then exited; request 3 was never answered (ai/service.ail:39 `if line == "" then ()`). A blank line is indistinguishable from EOF.
adversarial_probes.bad_config_empty_stdin: prints {"v":1,"type":"fatal",...,"detail":"config: unknown key openai"} even though no input arrived (ai/service.ail:96-100). Harmless, but the 'nothing before the first input' statement does not hold on the fatal path.
adversarial_probes.openrouter_only_key_set: text -> openrouter; portrait/avatar/voice -> no_key (route none). Correct; not one of the four shipped sets.

deviation_verdicts.config_via_args_json: ACCEPTED. argv needs Env; with Env the stub could read a key. Verified: under --caps IO,FS Env is refused at runtime, and the service never consults the environment even when Env is granted. The deviation is what makes the 'cannot spend' claim true.
deviation_verdicts.hello_routes_per_kind: ACCEPTED. routes {kind: {route, model} | {route: none, reason}} is strictly more informative than models {text,image,tts} and the goldens show the routing per key set. Design amendment documents the replacement; Godot (AI.6) consumes the new shape.
deviation_verdicts.error_meta_provider_route_and_text_only: ACCEPTED. meta {provider, route} on errors lets the relay tell no_key from a routed failure; text_only maps 1:1 to the sim's ai_cancel reason. Minor inconsistency noted: a bad_request detected after routing stamps the route (req 16 -> openrouter) while pre-routing ones stamp none.
deviation_verdicts.one_fatal_line_on_bad_config: ACCEPTED. Verified for five fault classes: exactly one fatal line, then exit; a second hello is not answered. Caveat: also printed when stdin is empty.
deviation_verdicts.spelled_out_numbers: ACCEPTED and required by D-21: the stub line must itself pass ai_numeral. Verified: no digit in any stub line across all goldens; 'two-zero' for 20.
deviation_verdicts.txt_text_blobs: ACCEPTED. It is what makes AC6's independent shasum check possible; design (a4) layout unchanged (ext per blob). Index lines mark origin library, no clock, so cache sums are reproducible.
deviation_verdicts.voice_provider_error_until_ai5: ACCEPTED WITH A FLAG. A routed voice request answering provider_error is a placeholder; it must not leak into AI.5/AI.6 goldens as 'expected' behaviour, and the relay will read it as a real provider failure (template fallback), which is the right conservative outcome meanwhile.
deviation_verdicts.fourth_key_set_text_only: ACCEPTED, adds value: it is the only automated proof that text_only blocks media while text still routes.
deviation_verdicts.loc_850_vs_cap_650: ACCEPTED WITH A NOTE. Counted myself: 469 code + 278 tests = 747 (plus 66 non-comment lines of mk/ai.mk and ~37 of config) against an estimate of 550 and a cap of 650. route.ail (71) was planned here, so the overrun is real (about 15% over the cap on code+tests, 30% with config), as with AI.2. The planning estimate for codec-heavy milestones runs low; AI.5's estimate should be revisited rather than this code trimmed.
deviation_verdicts.workarounds_1516_1517: ACCEPTED. Both cited at the site (provider.ail:81 avoids the name `words`; stub_test.ail:39-40 avoids `isErr`; wire_test.ail:41-43 replaces `_ :: x :: _` with two matches). The two-match form is equivalent. I did not verify the upstream filings (no network use beyond the PR view allowed to this evaluation).

non_blocking_findings.issue: `if line == "" then ()` treats an empty line as end of input; a blank line mid-stream ends the service silently and every later request goes unanswered (probe).
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Distinguish EOF from a blank line (skip blank lines, or answer bad_request with req "" and continue); add the case to tests/ai/requests.ndjson so the goldens pin it.

non_blocking_findings.issue: temp+rename and index-before-print (service.ail:45-46) are stated design invariants with no test: mutants removing the rename or swapping the order survive make test and make ai-stub.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: At least assert in ai-stub that no *.tmp remains and that index.ndjson line count == ok results; a crash-between-steps test is harder and may stay a documented risk.

non_blocking_findings.issue: errorCodes includes text_only but no decoder test covers it (dropping it survives all tests).
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Add a text_only error result line to wire_test.outLines.

non_blocking_findings.issue: ailang check warns: stapledons/ai/vm_test compiled but not listed in [exports].modules (the other test modules are listed).
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Add vm_test, or drop the test modules from exports and list only the six service modules.

non_blocking_findings.issue: news requests use max_chars 200 (mirrors sim/ai.ail:71 on main), but D-21 raised news to 280; the news over_length fixture (ai/fixtures/stub_text.json:14) is 219 chars, so once the sim adopts 280 it is no longer over length.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: When sim/ai.ail moves to 280 (not this PR), update the news fixture to exceed 280 and re-record the goldens.

non_blocking_findings.issue: A bad config with empty stdin still prints the fatal line (readLine returns "" and the fatal is printed anyway).
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Only print the fatal when a line actually arrived, or document that the fatal path is exempt from the silence rule.

non_blocking_findings.issue: The hello's cache_dir embeds .godot/tmp/ai/cache/<set>, so make ai-stub is coupled to SCRATCH := .godot/tmp (Makefile:7).
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Acceptable; note it in mk/ai.mk, or compare the hello with cache_dir normalised.

non_blocking_findings.issue: Status still says 'awaiting Mark's answers to the open questions'; D-20 answered them on 2026-10-02.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Update the status line at the next doc touch.

non_blocking_findings.issue: bad_request for an unknown stub_case is stamped with the resolved route (req 16 -> openrouter) while pre-routing bad_request stamps none.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Either is defensible; pick one and say so in the wire.ail header.

non_blocking_findings.issue: hello hardcodes provider 'stub' and live false instead of deriving them from the Provider value.
non_blocking_findings.suggestion: Derive from providerName when AI.5 wires the live providers.

non_blocking_findings.issue: No entry for AI.4 (landing step per CLAUDE.md).

evaluator_notes: Merge-ready from the evaluator's side. The blank-line termination (service.ail:39) is the one finding I would fix before Godot drives the service in AI.6; it is not blocking for AI.4 because the harness and the sim never emit a blank line. Probe programs, mutant copies and cache dirs were written to the session scratchpad only; the worktree's ai/ was restored with git checkout after each in-tree mutation and is clean.
